'''''Fate of the Jedi: Allies''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel and the fifth volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series. It was written by [[Christie Golden]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[May 25]], [[2010]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[April 26]], [[2011]].
